findings.title: UTC-midnight date values shift back one day in UTC− timezones
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the calendar date for UTC-midnight serialized date values; apply local-time correction only to values produced as local date strings, or normalize date-only values from their calendar components.
findings.first_evidence: In a UTC−7 browser, Python date(2019, 9, 20) serialized as 2019-09-20T00:00:00Z becomes local Sep 19 17:00. This code subtracts the +420-minute timezone offset, producing Sep 19 in the ISO date. The picker therefore displays Sep 19 for a Sep 20 model value. The same conversion is used for min_date and max_date.
